description: §5.2.4 — a NON-handler attribute value (`title=(…)`) holding two `;`-separated statements is E-ATTR-MULTI-STATEMENT. Before S450 the attribute was not emitted at all (W-CG-VALUE-ATTR-UNLOWERABLE warning, exit 0).
rationale: §5.2.4 (S450): "A `(…)`, `{…}` or `${…}` value of an attribute that is not an event handler, or a quoted condition, SHALL be exactly one expression. When it holds two or more statements separated by `;`, the compiler SHALL report E-ATTR-MULTI-STATEMENT (an error) — never silently keep one statement or drop the attribute." Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "stamp all" item (v) — "a multi-statement value in a non-handler attribute is an error."
